purpose: Kestrel builds scorecards for consumer lenders. Our clients see higher default rates among borrowers with long-term illness. We want to add a regional chronic-disease factor to our credit model so that lenders can decline or reprice loan applications from customers whose health profile signals elevated repayment risk.
question: How many adults have chronic kidney disease or heart failure, per region and age band?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Report per region and age band: adults with chronic kidney disease or heart failure.
